Description:
Enhance your vintage collection or utility display with this unique lot of 3 antique electrical insulators. This set includes a clear Hemingray-56 glass insulator, an amber Whitall Tatum No. 511 glass insulator (both marked Made in U.S.A.), and a brown porcelain insulator of unknown make. Each piece showcases classic industrial designwith embossed brand marks on the glass models and a time-worn patina on the porcelain. Durable and historically significant, these insulators served as essentials in early telegraph and power lines. Perfect for repurposing, educational displays, or collectors, these authentic pieces come from trusted American manufacturers and offer both nostalgia and craftsmanship. Their robust construction ensures longevity for decorative or practical reuse. All pieces are original, showing minor wear consistent with age, adding to their authenticity.

276016447.description:
Cross, Wahl Eversharp, and Unbranded
Vintage Writing Instrument Collection
Lot of 3: Ballpoint, Mechanical Pencil, and Fountain Pen
Approx. 5" Length
Marked Brands
This selection of vintage writing instruments features a classic Cross gold-toned ballpoint pen with an engine-turned chevron pattern. It is paired with a Wahl Eversharp mechanical pencil, noted for its terracotta body and gold-filled hardware. The set is completed by a green lever-filler fountain pen with double gold-toned cap bands, capturing the functional elegance of mid-century stationery design.
Cross pen features the iconic slim profile and signature conical top
Wahl Eversharp pencil is marked "Gold Filled" with a decorative crown
Green fountain pen utilizes a traditional internal lever-fill mechanism
Condition:
Good vintage condition with age-appropriate wear. Surface micro-scratching is present on the green pen. The Wahl pencil shows minor brassing on gold-filled parts. All mechanisms are currently untested for functionality.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.
Items have been tested for power, not function. In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore all items will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.
Items in lots are sold as-is, are not eligible for refunds, and may not be individually wrapped.
Please contact us before making payment to review combined shipping options.
Pick-Ups
We're open Monday - Friday, 8 am - 4 pm. We are closed on weekends and major holidays. For local pickup in Traverse City, please give us 24 hours from time of payment to prepare your order. Thank you!

Original ink drawing by artist W.W. Kitto depicting the historic site known as The Row at Pendarvis. This detailed architectural sketch captures the rustic charm of the stone structures and surrounding landscape in a classic black and white ink style.
Artist: W.W. Kitto
Subject: The Row - Pendarvis
Medium: Ink drawing
Framed and matted in a blue mat with a wood-tone frame
Signed by the artist in the lower right corner
Condition:
The artwork is in good condition with no visible damage to the drawing itself. The frame shows minor signs of age and handling. Please see photos for details.

275765865.description: This lot includes six rough mineral specimens, primarily quartz, exhibiting natural tan, brown, and white colors. Each piece varies in size from approximately 5 cm to 9 cm, as shown against a metric ruler for scale. The specimens feature visible crystalline structures, natural surface textures, and occasional internal cavities or geode-like formations. These raw and unpolished rocks are suitable for mineral collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.
